title: Code and data for: Staged 4E-BP1 phosphorylation creates two switches in series that give eIF4F memory
description: MATLAB code (scripts M01-M13, M15-M17 and one script per figure) that reproduces every result and figure of the article, the Mathematica notebook of the thermodynamic derivations, the parameter samples of every ensemble, the numerical results of our runs, and the 4E-BP1/eIF4F model in SBML (Level 3 Version 2) and XPPAUT formats. See README.md.
